review.why: Creates and edits dbt Semantic Layer parts (semantic models, entities, dimensions, metrics, time spine) in the latest or legacy YAML spec.
review.summary: First detects which spec the project uses and whether the dbt version supports it, offering an upgrade path for older versions. It then routes to a latest-spec or legacy-spec guide and shows a minimal example of each. Metric types include simple, derived, cumulative, ratio and conversion, with a time spine and best-practices guide.
strengths: Detects the existing spec and version before writing YAML
Minimal worked example for each spec
Treats upgrading as optional, not forced
cautions: Four reference files hold the full spec and are not read here
Spec versions will change with dbt releases
